## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or
specification section when useful.

## Validation

State which checks ran and their results. For an economic or ledger change,
include the invariant or failure case being exercised.

## Protocol impact

Describe changes to units, rounding, admission, authorization, state
transitions, or trust assumptions. For covenant work, include exact toolchain
versions and actual compilation/node validation evidence.
